meta.name: design-audit
meta.description: Make sure to use this skill whenever the user mentions reviewing UI consistency, auditing designs, checking UI rules, verifying frontend compliance, or when modifying/generating UI and frontend code to ensure strict adherence to the project's established design system (DESIGN.md/design-system.md).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计界面样式,确保与设计规范一致
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在写前端代码时担心界面与设计稿不一致
copy.tagline_en: Audit UI styles to ensure design spec compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you worry about UI breaking design specs while writing frontend code

howto.what: Claude 会先读取项目里的 DESIGN.md 或 design-system.md，提取颜色、字体、间距、交互状态等规则，再审查或生成前端代码，发现违反规则（如硬编码颜色、低对比度文字、缺少交互状态）时给出具体修正代码并解释原因。
howto.when: 当用户提到审查 UI 一致性、审计设计、检查 UI 规则等，或要求修改/生成 UI 及前端代码时触发。

say.text: 审查这段按钮代码是否遵守设计系统，并修正违规。
say.note: 会读取设计文档并返回修正代码。

say.text: 检查这个页面的文字对比度是否达到无障碍 AA 级标准。
say.note: 会标记不达标样式并提供替换代码。

say.text: 请先读取 DESIGN.md，再按规范生成这个组件。
say.note: 新代码会严格遵循项目设计系统。

howto.what_en: Claude reads DESIGN.md/design-system.md, extracts design rules (colors, typography, spacing, states), then audits or generates UI code. It flags violations like hardcoded colors, low contrast, missing states, and returns corrected code with explanation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions reviewing UI consistency, auditing designs, checking UI rules, etc., or asks to modify/generate UI and frontend code.

say_en.text: Review this button code for design-system compliance and fix violations.
say_en.note: Reads the design docs and returns corrected code.

say_en.text: Check this page's text contrast against WCAG AA.
say_en.note: Flags failing styles and suggests replacements.

say_en.text: Read DESIGN.md first, then generate this component by spec.
say_en.note: New code follows the project's design system.
